P.name: Perseverance
P.title: Template:Data Garen/Perseverance
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Perseverance|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Garen
|skill        = I
|icon         = Perseverance.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Garen}} continually {{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}} a portion of his {{sti|health|{{as|'''maximum''' health}}}}.
|blurb2       = This ability is temporarily disabled if he is attacked by epic {{tip|monsters}}, enemy {{tip|turrets}}, or enemy {{tip|champions}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Garen''' {{sti|health regeneration|link=true|regenerates}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|1.5+0.2*(x-1) for 6;then + 0.8*x for 7; then + 0.4*x|formula=1.3%+0.2% per level up to level 6, then+0.8% up to level 13, then+0.4%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|(1.5+0.2*(x-1))/10 for 6;then + 0.8/10*x for 7; then + 0.4/10*x|formula=0.13%+0.02% per level up to level 6, then+0.08% up to level 13, then+0.04%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}
|description2 = ''Perseverance'' is lost for {{tt|8 seconds|Not a cooldown, unaffected by ability haste}} if '''Garen''' takes damage from {{tip|champion|champions}}, epic {{tip|monster|monsters}}, or {{tip|turret|turrets}}, or if he is hit by an enemy {{tip|ability}} or affected by an enemy [[summoner spell]], refreshing on subsequent damage and hits taken from them.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|spelleffects = Heal 
|notes        = 
* ''Perseverance'' does not go on nor refresh its cooldown from damage which was:
** Reduced to or equal to [[Damage#0_Damage_Instances|0 damage]].
** Dealt to {{tip|shield|shields}}.
** Absorbed by {{tip|invulnerable|invulnerability}}.
|yvideo       = HrL_xlLHSW8
}}

Q.name: Decisive Strike
Q.title: Template:Data Garen/Decisive Strike
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Decisive Strike|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Garen
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Decisive Strike.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Garen}} gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} from {{tip|slow|slows}}.
|blurb2       = His next {{tip|basic attack}} will {{tip|lunge}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, {{tip|silence|silencing}} the target.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself of all {{tip|slow|slows}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|35% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a duration.
|leveling     = {{st|Movement Speed Duration|{{ap|1.4 to 3.6}}}}
|description2 = Additionally, '''Garen''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|4.5}} seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, {{tip|lunge}} at the target, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and {{tip|silence}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 150}} {{as|(+ 50% AD)}}}}
|description3 = ''Decisive Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Garen's''' basic attack timer.''
|cooldown     = 8
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cast time    = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = Special
|spelleffects = spell
|parry        = True
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = False
|notes        = 
* The enhanced attack will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal (the bonus damage does not).
** The bonus damage will also apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
** The bonus damage is applied to {{tip|structures}}.
* ''Decisive Strike'' locks '''Garen''' out of using basic attacks for a short period of time.<!--The enhanced attack or the ability itself?--> This is shortened with {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}}.
* The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become {{tip|untargetable}} during the {{tip|attack windup|attack's windup}}.
* ''Decisive Strike'' will not prevent the reapplication of {{tip|slow|slows}} (e.g. the persistent slow from {{ai|Pillar of Ice|Trundle}} will be immediately reapplied after removal if '''Garen''' is still within its [[area of effect]]).
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only negate the {{tip|silence}}.
* ''Decisive Strike's'' {{tip|lunge}} can pass very thin terrain and will otherwise not be able to. In any case, '''Garen''' will still hit his target.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qi54mu_gxg]
|yvideo       = ZBh4Fc4j2Yc
}}

W.name: Courage
W.title: Template:Data Garen/Courage
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Courage|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Garen
|skill        = W
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Garen}} permanently gains '''bonus''' {{as|{{sti|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic resistance|{{as|magic resist}}}} by killing enemies, up to a cap. Upon reaching the cap, he gains another permanent boost to these defenses.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' reduces incoming damage for a few seconds. He also briefly gains a {{tip|shield}} and increased {{tip|tenacity}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Garen''' kills an enemy, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Courage'', stacking up to 150 times.
|description2 = {{sbc|Courage:}} For each stack, '''Garen''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|{{fd|0.2}} '''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|{{fd|0.2}} '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, up to a maximum of 30 '''bonus''' resistances each.
|icon3        = Courage.png
|description3 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' reduces incoming damage for 4 seconds. For the first {{fd|0.75}} seconds, '''Garen''' additionally grants himself a {{tip|shield}} and 60% {{tip|tenacity}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Damage Reduction|{{ap|25 to 41}}%}}
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 18% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|22 to 12}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time    = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self 
|notes        = 
* ''Courage's'' bonus resistances are only gained when it is ranked up at least once, but ''Courage's'' passive is retroactive for units killed before it was learned.
* ''Courage's'' '''bonus''' resistances can be obtained by any of '''Garen's''' damage sources (basic attacks, abilities, summoner spells, runes, item actives).
** This does not include ''last hits'' transferred to '''Garen''' artificially.
* The kills on these enemy unit types count towards ''Courage'' stacks:
** {{tip|champion|Champions}} (Only [[kill]]s, [[assist]]s don't grant stacks)
** All {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monster|monsters}}
** [[Champion summoned units]] (e.g. {{ai|Noxious Trap|Teemo}}, {{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}})
** All {{tip|pet|pets}} and {{tip|clone|clones}}.
*** The bonus is equal for all these units; ''large'' units do not grant a larger bonus.
* The kills on these enemy unit types do '''not''' count towards ''Courage'' stacks:
** {{tip|Wards}}.
** {{tip|Turrets}} (including {{ai|Shurima's Legacy|Azir|Sun Disk}}) and other {{tip|structures}}
** [[Jungle plants]].
** Units destroyed by 'trampling' such as {{cai|Rampant Growth|Zyra|seeds}}, {{cai|Cell Division|Zac|goo}} or {{cai|Tunnel|Rek'Sai|tunnels}}.
** {{cai|I|Illaoi|Tentacles}} and {{cai|Dark Procession|Yorick}}
* ''Courage'' will only grant bonus resistances from units killed by '''Garen''' himself. {{ii|Eye of the Herald}} does not count.
* The {{tip|Tenacity}} increase {{tip|stacks additively}} with the ''tenacity reduction'' from {{tip|Brittle}}, but multiplicatively with other sources.
}}

|description2 = Enemy champions hit 6 times by ''Judgment'' are inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|25% armor reduction}}}} for 6 seconds, with the duration refreshing upon the 7th hit and every 6th hit thereafter.
|icon3        = Judgment 3.png
|description3 = ''Judgment'' deals {{ap|({{#var:near}}-1)*100}}% increased damage against the nearest enemy hit. 
|leveling3    = {{st|Increased Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*{{#var:near}} to 16*{{#var:near}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*{{#var:near}} to {{#var:ad5}}*{{#var:near}}}}% AD)}}|Increased Critical Strike Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:crit}}) to 16*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:crit}})}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:crit}}) to {{#var:ad5}}*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:crit}})}}% AD)}}|Increased {{ii|Infinity Edge|IE}} Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}}) to 16*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}})}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}}) to {{#var:ad5}}*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}})}}% AD)}}}}
|icon4        = Judgment 2.png
|description4 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Garen''' ends ''Judgment''.
|description5 = ''Judgment'' can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{#expr:100+{{#var:crit}}*100}}|{{#expr:{{#var:crit}}*100}}}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|{{#expr:{{#var:crit}}*100}}% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|9 to 6}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 325
|targeting    = Auto
|cast time    = none
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = false
|spelleffects = aoedot
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* At level 20, '''Garen''' will spin a minimum of {{ap|{{#var:spin_b}}+{{#expr:floor(({{ccd|Garen|as_lvl}}*(20-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(20-1)))/{{#var:spin_as}})}}}} times.
* Deactivating the ability manually does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Each spin triggers a stack of {{ri|Conqueror}}.
* For the purpose of moving closer to an enemy when right clicking them, ''Judgment'' also reduces '''Garen's''' {{sti|attack range|link=range}} {{ft|to 100|by 75}} for the duration.
* ''Judgment'' only scales with {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} from items and growth (per level).
* ''Judgment'' cancels '''Garen's''' last movement command upon ending.
* Each spin deals damage simultaneously to all enemies within its range when the spin is completed.
* The spin animation is capped at {{as|{{tt|200%|Once per 0.2 seconds, 15 spins total}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}, but the amount of ticks will keep on scaling.
* The armor reduction stacks multiplicatively with other percentage armor penetration effects.
{{ct|attack=false|cast={{ai|Decisive Strike|Garen}} and {{ai|Courage|Garen}} are usable. {{ai|Demacian Justice|Garen}} interrupts.|move=true|items=true|consume=true|spells=true,true,true,false,true|interrupts=death}}
|yvideo       = fZMuLPyKYho
}}

|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' calls upon the might of ''Demacia'' onto the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing them {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} as well as {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for 1 second at the start of the cast time.
